info.name: Apache OFBiz REST Authentication Services API
Apache OFBiz List All Exported Services

items.docs: Returns a list of all OFBiz services that have been exported via the REST plugin (export="true" with verb="get" or verb="post").

info.name: Apache OFBiz Invoke Service via GET

params.name: serviceName
params.description: The name of the OFBiz service to invoke.

params.name: inParams
params.description: URL-encoded JSON string of service input parameters.

items.docs: Invoke an exported OFBiz service using HTTP GET. Input parameters must be passed as a URL-encoded JSON string in the inParams query parameter. Only services exported with verb="get" support this method.

info.name: Apache OFBiz Invoke Service via POST

params.name: serviceName
params.description: The name of the OFBiz service to invoke.

items.docs: Invoke an exported OFBiz service using HTTP POST. Input parameters are passed as a JSON request body. Only services exported with verb="post" support this method.
